A_7X1.portfolio_construction: each portfolio is one single phase curve C07_Pf for f in [0..6]

B_10X2.portfolio_construction: each portfolio is simple mean of two phase curves (f, f+5) for f in [0..4]

C_9X3.portfolio_construction: each portfolio is simple mean of three phase curves (f, f+3, f+6) for f in [0..2]

fixed_cost_model.note_days_definition: distinct trade days with at least one rebalance event across sleeves plus distinct days with defensive_sell outside rebalance; phase-staggered sleeves do not collide on rebalance days

G1_mechanics.description: for each of 26 sweep runs, sum(is_rebalance_day) equals count of indices where idx % cadence == phase

G2_aggregation.description: native-vs-proxy equivalence for 10x2 using phases 0 and 5
G2_aggregation.native_definition: sum of two sleeves run natively with BASE_CAPITAL=50000 each for cadence=10 phases 0 and 5
G2_aggregation.proxy_definition: simple mean of the two 100k phase curves cadence=10 phases 0 and 5

G3_completeness.description: all 26/26 sweep runs have both TRAIN and HOLDOUT rows

decision_rule.tie_breaker: if abs(sharpe_mean_winner - sharpe_mean_A_7X1) < 0.05 then A_7X1 wins
